title: Black Mesa
provenance: Reported by Swiss-Mac-User (highball#385, highball#386, 2026-10-18), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.19: on the Wine 11 engine r27 with DXVK the GPU device is lost (MoltenVK 'Internal Error (0000010d)', the error Portal 2's HDR pass caused), and on the default engine r28 in a DXMT environment the game needs -oldgameui in Steam's launch options, loads for a couple of minutes and runs at 5 fps at most. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Unplayable for the one report so far: the GPU device is lost on DXVK, and in a DXMT environment (where Direct3D 9 still goes through DXVK) it needs -oldgameui and runs at about 5 fps. The device loss is the same Metal error Portal 2's HDR exposure pass caused, which Source's mat_tonemapping_occlusion_use_stencil 1 fixed there; untested on Black Mesa.

knownIssues.symptom: GPU device lost (MoltenVK Internal Error 0000010d) on DXVK
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed here; the same error came from Source's HDR exposure pass in Portal 2
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. Untested: mat_tonemapping_occlusion_use_stencil 1 in the game's autoexec.cfg, as Portal 2's fix does

knownIssues.symptom: About 5 fps, and the game needs -oldgameui to start, in a DXMT environment
